interpretations: For each `telescref` with at least one non-NULL `modindex`, calculate its average `modindex`; compute the overall average as the mean of those telescope averages; return the 10 telescopes whose averages are strictly higher, with `telescref`, telescope average, telescope average minus overall average, and telescope average divided by overall average, ordered by that ratio descending, without rounding.
queries:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
    SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS telescope_average
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY telescref
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(telescope_average) AS overall_average
    FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT
    t.telescref,
    t.telescope_average,
    t.telescope_average - o.overall_average AS difference,
    t.telescope_average / o.overall_average AS ratio
FROM telescope_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE t.telescope_average > o.overall_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
